skillFull: Mimics the power of Nature within her mirror at certain intervals, using the power of an Elemental Cookie. Fire Spirit Cookie's power creates a path of fire to blast forward, Moonlight Cookie's sends forth three shooting stars, Sea Fairy Cookie's sends forth a Wave Bead, and Wind Archer Cookie's sends arrows of wind. Level Up for more Mimicked Elemental Power Points and more points for Mimicked Elemental Jellies.
story:
If you hear a faint, eerie laughter and experience an unusual lack of energy... It means that Agar Agar Cookie is lurking nearby! This Cookie, beset with an ever-present magical hunger, might appear sluggish, but make no mistake: slowly but inevitably, she will move towards a new source of Life Energy to sustain herself.

Little is known about this mystical creature who spent a long time dwelling at the bottom of a forgotten well dripping with briny seawater—formless, shadow-like. Agar Agar Cookie's fate took a new turn when the lid of her well was opened by a crimson priestess. Having gained a purpose from this unexpected visitor, Agar Agar Cookie took on an appearance reminiscent of her new ally.

One thing is for certain: if you ever see a shadow, gazing at you with crimson eyes, start praying. For there is little you can do...

costumes.info: Darkness takes root easily in fragile hearts. The long wait is over... No more enduring at the bottom of a forgotten,(sic) well, no more searching for an answer that never comes. Now, her crimson eyes, answering to the master of Darkness, pierce straight through the abyssal dark to seize power of the deepest depths and bind it within the mirror... The shadows nestled in the hearts of others will never escape her gaze. The Harbinger of the Depths sees all. You can run, but you can't hide.+125,000 for Mimicked Elemental Power Points

candy.skillFull: Stregthens the mimicked elemental powers. Fire Spirit Cookie's path of fire triggers a secondary explosion, Moonlight Cookie's power gains one extra star, Sea Fairy Cookie's periodically sends a more powerful Wave Bead, and Wind Archer Cookie's final arrow becomes a giant wind arrow, The greater the enchanted power, the more points for Mimicked Elemental Jellies.
